dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
The Boss... at the Thumb summit? ... Huh.
在拇指的会议上……老大被……哈啊。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Got it... Thanks for the warning.
这样啊……感谢通知。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
I'll carry your name to the grave even if we end up getting Purged.
就算我被肃清了，也不会说出你的名字的，不用担心。

Resting his gaze on the skyscrapers outside the window, the child lit his cigar.
孩子望着窗外矗立着的高楼，点燃了雪茄。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
*puff* I told him to watch his mouth since the Thumb Sottocapo would be attending the summit.
哈啊……我明明和他说过那么多次了，拇指的二老板会出席会议，要注意言辞。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
And yet, he's finally done it... and it couldn't have been a more spectacular fail, too.
结果出事了。还是大事。

Syndicates that swarm into a Collapsed Wing all have similar interests:
后巷的帮派们聚集在被折断之翼的目的都大差不差。

Lay claim to at least one of the many alleyways of the Backstreets, and keep a tight grip on it until they can sell it to a new L Corp. that will one day rise as a Wing.
为了抢占L公司巷中的至少一隅，等日后新L公司入驻时，能收取补偿金卖给他们。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
The Thumb's probably set its sights on these parts if Famiglia Laterano and the Kurokumo Clan are pulling back.
既然拉特朗家族和黑云会撤退了，那么拇指便会对这里动起贪念吧。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
The Sette Famiglie ain't getting pushed out, though... which can only mean that the leading member Syndicates still get to keep their cuts.
从七大家族没有被责罚来看……是帮派的领导阶层在……照顾他们吧。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Subsidiaries like us are the ones breaking backs... *exhale* only for the Thumb to swoop in and stake its ground.
明明辛苦工作的是我们这些下属帮派……唉……可到头来，拿走地块的却是拇指啊。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content: As for our hot-blooded Boss... Guess he just couldn't help asking why we gotta pull out empty-handed. 以老大的性子……大概是上头了。问了“凭什么我们要空手而归”吧。

The Night Awls, which the child is a member of, was one of the Syndicates vying to claim their slice of the pie in the absence of the Collapsed L Corp.—all with the Thumb's permission, of course.
孩子所属的帮派，夜锥组，也在拇指的许可下插足了L公司中的利益纷争……

However, they were forced to take their hands off the whole business simply at the whim of the Capo dei Capi, the "Padrino" of the Thumb.
但因为教父改了主意，所以不得不从L公司退出。

Perhaps he thought it too unfair,
是因为那份不甘太过强烈了吗？

but the leader of the Night Awls couldn't hold his temper in check and asked the one question he should never have dared to ask.
孩子的老大……在会场上没法压抑感情，问出了一个不该说出口的问题。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
*puff* What difference did he hope to make by second-guessing the Padrino's intentions?
唉……就算他知道了教父大人的心意，又能改变得了什么呢？

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
A bit of careless talk... and we're suddenly painted red for the Purge.
就因为那句轻率之言……夜锥组落了个被肃清的下场啊。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Hard to believe the same unease I felt back when we were the Enforcers of the Purge... is happening for real.
曾在家族里当肃清者时，仅存在于想象中的事情……就这样成了现实。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Anyone outside?
外面的在吗？

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
Yes, Capitano?
您叫我吗，队长。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Send up the remaining crew to my office.
让所有留在这座建筑里的家族成员都来我的房间。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
And... make sure to let them know what I'm about to say. Don't leave out a single word.
然后……把接下来我说的话，一字不落地传达给他们。

The child gathered up what was remaining of the crew at headquarters...
孩子把建筑里留下的帮派成员全都叫到了一起……

But not the ones outside. He couldn't let the Thumb find out that the Night Awls had been forewarned.
但为了不让拇指知道事态已经被察觉，所以一个外面的帮派成员都没有喊。

No sense in dying for the ones who're already doomed, he told himself.
他告诉自己，能活下去的人必须得活下去。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Is everyone here?
全员都到齐了吗。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
You all must've heard about what happened... at the Thumb Summit.
你们都听说拇指会议上……发生的事情了吧。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
We all knew the Boss had a habit of jumping the gun... But none of us even had an inkling it'd turn out like this.
老大……虽然平时就有过轻率的言行……但我从没想过他会做出这种事情。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.teller:
Desperate Subordinate
豁出性命的帮派成员
dataList.content:
... Can't wrap my head around it. To think he had the audacity to question the Capo dei Capi's intentions...
……难以置信。老大竟敢质疑教父大人的意思……

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.teller:
Desperate Subordinate
豁出性命的帮派成员
dataList.content:
Is it our turn to get Purged now?
接下来我们会被肃清吗？

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
After everything we did to Purge the other Syndicates... How could it possibly turn on us?
一直在到处狩猎帮派的我们……这次竟然反过来成了目标，真是难以置信。

It wasn't surprising at all that the rank and file started to blame their dead Boss.
理所当然地，帮派成员间陆续传来了埋怨声。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content: ... Why couldn't you be our Boss, Capitano? ……要是队长您来当这个老大就好了。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
No use thinking about shoulda coulda wouldas.
无意义的假设就到此为止吧。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
We can't deny it was that young streak of his that helped us expand this far.
正是因为老大年轻气盛，帮派才得以壮大，这是不可否认的事实。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Me... I liked being out in the field, getting a little action. The Boss might've been impatient as hell... but damn if he didn't know how to keep us in business.
我的……性子适合呆在工作现场。老大虽然为人轻率……但他揽活的本事确实不错。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
*puff* For now, we gotta think of ways to stay alive. You can spit on the Boss's grave later once we've saved our own necks.
唉……得考虑活下去的方法了。要对已死的老大吐口水的话，之后也不迟。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
... How about we cut through L Corp.'s Nest and get to the other side of the Backstreets before the heat catches on?
……从L公司的巢逃去另一边的后巷怎么样。

Fortunately enough, it was raining in District 12.
正好，12区在下雨。

The Nest of L. Corp, shrouded in a thick blanket of fog following its Collapse... was a perfect place to move without drawing eyes.
L公司没落以后，被浓雾笼罩的巢……是隐藏身形的绝佳场所。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
... Any thoughts on where to go from there?
……那最终的落脚点呢？

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
How about... V Corp.?
V公司……如何？

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
I heard some kind of monster tore through their Nest and left it looking like a butcher's floor... The whole place is a real mess.
我听说那里自奇怪的怪物虐杀巢中居民以来……就一直处于混乱状态。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content: By now, though... there should be somewhere we can stay holed up if we can get there. 现在的话……说不定有能供我们藏身的地方吧？

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Not a bad idea...
目的地……不错。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
But the question is, how do we even get there?
但是……应该没有能够逃脱的路。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
L Corp.'s Nest and Backstreets... have long turned into a hellhole where all kinds of pests come crawling in.
L公司的巢与后巷……从很久以前就成了各类虫豸出没的魔窟。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Thumb subsidiaries like us, R Corp., and even Liu Association are all stirring the place up like vultures on a carcass.
除了像我们这样的拇指下属帮派，还有食指、R公司、甚至是六协会，都在搅和着L公司。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
One wrong move... and we'd be dead before we even manage to get away.
搞不好……我们在逃出去前就会死啊。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
I say we lay low till sundown. We could use the Night in the Backstreets as cover to get out.
要是如此，我们就暂且藏身，然后趁着后巷深宵逃跑如何？

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Wings may Collapse... but don't forget that Nests are still out of reach for Sweepers.
即使翼没落了……清道夫们也不会越过巢的边界。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Getting out of L Corp.'s Nest is one thing; getting away from waves of Sweepers when we're dead on our feet is another.
反而是……疲惫不堪而又试图逃出巢的我们，很有可能被清道夫的浪潮吞没。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组

Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
So there's really no way out...
能够逃脱的方法……看来没有啊。

With everyone at their wits' end, a stifling silence fell upon the room...
在所有人都无法掩盖不知所措的情绪时……

But the child remembered that they still had a way out.
孩子想起了一个没有对任何人说过的逃生口。

His instincts kept screaming that this might be jumping out of the frying pan into the fire,
孩子的理性肯定在不停警告他前往那里很危险。

however, the fact was that the Night Awls simply had no other choice.
然而……现在没有其他选项了。

The child's decision was already swaying toward the only exit available.
孩子内心所偏向的，大概是脑海中浮现的唯一一条逃生通道吧。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
... We go to the Library.
……我们去图书馆吧。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
You managed to get an Invitation?
您是拿到了邀请函吗？

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
No. It was already on my desk when I heard what happened to the Boss...
不。听到老大的下场时，我看向桌子，发现不知不觉间它已经被放在那里了。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
... as if we were being summoned there.
简直像是在召唤我们一样。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组

dataList.content:
Though the child's knowledge was by no means necessary for the collection of the One True Book...
虽然对于收集那本唯一而完美的书来说，孩子的知识并不是必要的……

I still hoped that the Library had a bookshelf to house the child's desperation for survival.
我仍希望图书馆能将孩子心中的对活着的迫切渴望一并接纳。

Because that's why I'd had that Invitation given to him.
正因如此，我才给了这孩子邀请函。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
... If that's our Capitano's order... We follow.
……我服从。如果这是队长您的命令的话。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
*inhale* Drop the formalities. We're on the same boat—we don't have the time to mind the Thumb's rules between us at this point.
唉……无所谓了。我们都沦落到了这个地步，也顾不上什么拇指的规矩了。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Just speak up if you have any suggestions. We need all the ideas we can get if we want to increase the odds of our survival.
有意见就尽管提吧。这样大家活下去的概率才会更高。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
Going to the Library... is way too risky.
……图书馆太过危险了。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
Word is, even Grade 1-Fixer Offices are backing out of any contracts that have to do with the Library. Imagine those money hounds actually eating penalty fees just to stay away.
我听说就算是1阶收尾人事务所，也在全面取消与图书馆相关的委托。那群视财如命的家伙们……甚至不惜支付巨额违约金。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.teller:
Desperate Subordinate
豁出性命的帮派成员
dataList.content:
Not just the Fixer Offices. Even the Fingers are calling it a graveyard—there were Index Proselytes who went missing there not long ago...
恐慌的可不止事务所呢？就连手指都喊那个地方坟场。前几天消失的食指苦行者们也……

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
... The Index, huh.
……食指吗。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Of course, the Index. Now that I think about it, they went to the Library too.
没错，食指。他们也去了图书馆。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
And if there's any truth to that rumor... we might be able to gather valuable intel on the Index in the Library.
要是传言为真……在图书馆里应该能得到有关食指的情报吧。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
The Book of the Index. That would be bargain enough for the Thumb to overlook our Boss's insolence.
食指之书。要是有那种分量的贡品，拇指……宽恕老大无礼行为的可能也很高。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
Are you sure about this?
您认真的吗？

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
There's not much time left before we're Purged to the last man. Those of you who're thinking of backing out, now's the time.
离肃清已经没多少时间了。不想跟来的家伙们，现在就逃吧。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
I... I'm going to put my name on the Invitation.
我……会在邀请函上签名。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.teller:
Desperate Subordinate
豁出性命的帮派成员
dataList.content:
... It's been an honor, Capitano.
……很长时间以来承蒙您关照了，队长。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.teller:
Decorous Subordinate
彬彬有礼的帮派成员
dataList.content:
Hope we meet again someday, Capitano. I hope you'll survive no matter what.
希望有朝一日还能与您再见。请一定要活下来。

Some of the crew bowed deeply to the child and left the office.
有几名帮派成员向那孩子鞠躬致意后，离开了办公室……

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
... I trust in your judgement.
……我相信队长您的判断。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
Rumors always get blown up. The Library, eh? I'm pretty confident we can bring it down.
传闻总是被过度夸大的。图书馆……我们一定能将其讨伐。

The majority, on the other hand, stayed and waited for the child to sign the Invitation.
大部分人都留了下来，等待着孩子的签名。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
... Let's set off.
……出发吧。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
I'd thought the rumors were exaggerated...
我还以为只是夸张的传闻……

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content: Guess there's a reason they call it the Library. Never imagined it'd be this massive. 所以这里才被叫作图书馆吗。竟具有如此庞大的规模。

dataList.title:
Library Director
图书馆 馆长
dataList.content:
Greetings, dear guests.
各位来宾，欢迎你们的到来。

dataList.title:
Library Director
图书馆 馆长
dataList.content:
May you find your book in this place.
那么，正于此地，愿您找到想要的书。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
*puff* Figured nothing really fazes you past a certain age.
呼……活久了还真是什么都能见到啊。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
To think that a Fixer in the uniform of Shi Association's South Section would show off Kurokumo's sword technique...
想不到身穿南部し协会制服的收尾人，手里竟然使出了黑云会的剑法……

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
... and is that R Corp.'s combat style this time? Color me surprised.
这回连R公司的技术都见着了。

With calm and calculated footwork, the child slid past the gleaming arc of an Assistant Librarian's orange blade.
冷静地一一挡下了由司书所持的、复制出的剑所描绘出的橙色轨迹……

A sudden thrust attack immediately followed, but the child sidestepped it and pressed into his opponent's outstretched arms.
连不期而至的刺击都躲过了的那孩子，瞬间冲至了司书胸前。

dataList.title:
Floor of History
历史层
dataList.content:
Hrrk...!
咕呃！

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Not a single opening to strike...
……无隙可乘吗。

However, the child's pointed peg leg, which sparked as it raked across the floor, was blocked before it could pierce through the opponent's neck.
但……那孩子擦过地面、火花迸溅的锥，最终没能贯穿那司书的头颅，而是在那之前被挡了下来。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
Are you alright, Capitano?!
队长，您还好吗？

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Not in the slightest.
没事。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
Thought we at least had some fighting chance when we took down that Index Proselyte wielding Liu Association's flames...
打倒操纵六协会火焰的食指苦行者之后……我还以为我们能看到点希望呢……

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
*exhale* How many of us are still standing?
呼……我们还剩多少战力？

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
... Half of our men are dead.
……带来的人员中已经有半数战死。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
These Librarians... the rumors have got nothing on these monsters.
这些图书馆的司书……真是比传闻中还要厉害得多的怪物呢。

dataList.title:
Night Awls
夜锥组
dataList.content:
Shouldn't we just call it quits and cut our losses?
我们再这样战斗下去还有意义吗？

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长

Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
These bastards... are no monsters.
这些家伙……不是什么怪物。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
They're humans, just like us. Humans who are afraid of getting killed.
他们与我们一样，是恐惧死亡的人类。

dataList.title:
Night Awls Capitano
夜锥组 队长
dataList.content:
They must have a gap or two we can exploit.
肯定也有弱点。

For an instant, a surge of emotion cracked the child's mask of composure before he impaled the Librarian, killing them.
